title: What runs in a browser vs on a server?
description: Trace browser and server execution, inspect delivered assets, and build a local HTTP application that keeps private data on the server.
objectives: Identify which environment executes given code
Explain why public browser code must not contain credentials
Build a server that returns HTML and a separate browser script
Verify that private values are excluded from public responses
rubric: I inspected the document and JavaScript in the Network panel.
I completed the starter and passed the local acceptance tests.
I confirmed that the private sentinel is absent from responses.
